requirement:
`--config <name>` MUST select a configuration for that invocation. Otherwise,
authoring MUST use the user's selection for the canonical project root, then the
workspace default, then the user's default. Named workspace configurations MUST
override same-named user configurations as complete records. Backend, model,
connection settings, and options MUST come from the selected record as a unit;
fields MUST NOT be merged between records. Workspace-only authoring MUST work
without a user configuration file. Missing configuration or an unknown selection
MUST identify the relevant configuration file and point to documented examples.

An explicit Bedrock AWS profile or region MUST override the corresponding SDK
default; omitted values MUST use standard AWS SDK resolution. Ollama MUST use
its configured endpoint or `http://localhost:11434`. If `api_key_env` is set, its
named variable MUST supply the credential; a missing or empty value MUST produce
an error before a model request.
rationale:
I found no gap in the code or the tests for any obligation in `requirements.authoring.configuration_precedence`.

**Implementation.** The subject's `{impl}` items are `author_all`, `config.rs#fn[resolve_authoring_from]` and `main` (`Command::Author`). They reach the resolution code through `author_evidence_with_options`/`configured_assessment` and `run_batch`, which call `config::resolve_authoring`, which calls `resolve_authoring_with_workspace_from`. They also reach the provider connection code.

| Obligation | Code |
|---|---|
| `--config <name>` selects a configuration for the invocation. | `explicit` is the first alternative in the `selected` chain in `resolve_authoring_with_workspace_from`. |
| Otherwise, use the user's selection for the canonical project root, then the workspace default, then the user default. | The project root is canonicalized with `fs::canonicalize`. The chain then tries `authoring.projects.get(&project_root)`, then `local.default`, then `authoring.default`. |
| Named workspace configurations override same-named user configurations as complete records. | `configured` looks in `local.configs` first and falls back to `authoring.configs`. |
| Backend, model, connection settings and options come from the selected record as a unit, with no field merging. | `ResolvedAuthoringConfig` is built from the single selected `config` (`concurrency`, `policy`, `backend`). |
| Workspace-only authoring works without a user configuration file. | `user` is `Option`, and the code errors only if both `authoring` and `local` are `None`. |
| Missing configuration or an unknown selection identifies the relevant file and points to documented examples. | Errors use `invalid(path, …)` with `searched …` and `CONFIG_EXAMPLES`. An unknown selection is reported against the file that made the selection (`selection_path`). |
| An explicit Bedrock profile or region overrides the SDK default, and omitted values use standard SDK resolution. | `providers.rs#fn[bedrock_sdk_loader]` sets `profile_name` and `region` only when they are `Some`. |
| Ollama uses its configured endpoint or `http://localhost:11434`. | `OllamaConfig::endpoint` is `self.endpoint.as_deref().unwrap_or("http://localhost:11434")`. `RigProvider::connect` passes it to `with_base_url`. |
| If `api_key_env` is set, its named variable supplies the credential, and a missing or empty value is an error before a model request. | `OllamaConfig::api_key_from` rejects a missing, empty or non-UTF-8 value. `connect` calls `config.api_key()?` while building the provider. `validate` rejects a configuration that sets both `api_key` and `api_key_env`. |

**Tests.**
- Explicit, project, default and workspace-default precedence, and whole-record selection: `tests/configuration.rs#fn[explicit_project_and_default_selections_choose_whole_configs]` and `#fn[workspace_defaults_and_configs_combine_with_existing_user_selections]`.
- Whole-record override of same-named user configurations, with no field merging: `#fn[workspace_defaults_and_configs_combine_with_existing_user_selections]`, which asserts that `concurrency` and `endpoint` are not inherited, and `#fn[workspace_configurations_accept_validate_and_override_concurrency]`.
- Workspace-only authoring with no user file: `#fn[workspace_defaults_and_configs_combine_with_existing_user_selections]` passes `None` for the user configuration. `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[authoring_uses_nearest_workspace_configuration_without_a_user_file]` runs the whole CLI without one.
- Missing and unknown selections naming the file and pointing to examples: `#fn[explicit_project_and_default_selections_choose_whole_configs]` (including the missing-configuration case), `#fn[configurations_without_any_selection_report_how_to_choose_one]` and `#fn[unknown_selections_name_the_file_that_made_them]`.
- Bedrock profile and region: `providers.rs#mod[tests]/fn[omitted_bedrock_profile_and_region_use_standard_sdk_resolution]` and `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[bedrock_cli_uses_selected_profile_region_and_converse_tools]`.
- Ollama default and configured endpoints: `tests/configuration.rs#fn[backend_configuration_round_trips_without_materializing_defaults]` asserts the default endpoint. The CLI tests in `tests/authoring_cli.rs` use a configured endpoint.
- `api_key_env`: the unit test `tests/configuration.rs#fn[ollama_authentication_resolves_separately_and_rejects_missing_values]` covers the unset, empty and set cases. `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[missing_or_empty_api_key_env_fails_before_any_model_request]` checks that the endpoint is never contacted.

I found no unspecified behavior that needs its own specification.
